chapter: Cee Pee Johnson, Hampton and the Navy band
title: The swing band's book, battle of bands and Captain King
summary: Royal's band used Basie and Lunceford arrangements, beat the Coast Guard band, and he praises Captain C.W. King.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: The swing band, what kind of did you have?

We had good arrangements. I had half of Basie's book. I had part of Lunceford's book and a whole lot of things from Jimmy Mundy (PHONETIC) and all the big-time arrangers, had a real hot band. It was very good. We played for all the football things, all the baseball games and things. We used to have a battle of bands with the Coast Guard Band, that

was up there, Pete Rugolo and those guys, we'd run them off the field. We were so hot. We were positively the leading band they had. I got a lot of citations and things from the government for well-dones, which was nice.

We had real gentleman-like people that we worked around in the Navy formation, people that were actually in public life, respected people and people that weren't so much Army, Navy, as down-to-earth people, had a very good captain on our base, Captain C.W. King. Before he got in the service, he was connected with the Coca-Cola Bottling Company and things like that. He was a good man. It was a nice tour of duty.
